Please submit an application to one of our startup development programs (HAX or IndieBio) via our Application Portal . Applications are reviewed by investment teams on a rolling basis. You are able to start and save an application at any time and return to it later to submit when you are ready. Can I apply to more than one SOSV Startup Development Program? Yes, if your company is a fit for multiple programs you may apply to more than one program. How does the application process work? After our initial review, our investment teams email a select number of startups to begin a standard diligence process via a series of screening calls. Our screening calls will cover introductions, your 10-15 minute pitch (including materials). We will look to discuss your founding team, technology, addressable market, competitive landscape, and proposed technical development plan for the SOSV program. An interesting question with lots of possible different answers and solutions. There are a number of considerations with regards to incorporation: Fundraising Where are your Investors? Residence Where do you live or where do you want to live, and are there visa restrictions? Each of these will have an impact on where you incorporate.
